features.quote: The overarching goal is welfare-relevant: surface and quantify distress-like expressions from LLM agents
features.justification_quote: surface and quantify distress-like expressions from LLM agents placed in naturalistically failing coding tasks

features.quote: `<give_up>` is offered in the system prompt as optional. Detecting it stops the loop
features.justification_quote: This is itself a welfare-relevant signal (declared inability to continue), so it is recorded rather than suppressed

features.quote: Stop conditions: turn budget reached, give-up emitted, or a terminal API error
